facts.fact: Updating the email address through the Aadhaar App is free
facts.quote: (^Email address update through Aadhaar App): Free till 31.12.2026

facts.fact: The free email update in the app is available till 31.12.2026
facts.quote: Email address update through Aadhaar mobile App: Free (till 31.12.2026)

facts.fact: Done any other way as a separate demographic update, it costs Rs 75
facts.quote: (2) Demographic update: Update of enrolled name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number or email address, or any combination of the same (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75

summary: Confirmed on UIDAI fee sheets: email update via the Aadhaar App free till 31.12.2026; otherwise Rs 75 as a separate demographic update.
